channel.title: CVE Daily — AI Curated
channel.description: Today's vulnerability landscape is dominated by critical remote code execution and privilege escalation flaws within the Microsoft ecosystem, impacting desktop environments via Edge and Windows services, cloud infrastructure through Azure and SharePoint, and developer tools like Visual Studio Code. Parallel high-severity risks affect IoT networking gear from manufacturers such as D-Link and Totolink due to hardcoded backdoors and buffer overflows, alongside significant injection and deserialization vulnerabilities compromising database middleware and web-facing enterprise applications. These diverse attack vectors collectively threaten endpoint security, cloud tenant isolation, and the integrity of industrial and medical control systems requiring immediate remediation.
